Restore steps rebuild_logic_projection_and_w3c_boundary and run_conformance_security_mission_thread_replay are recorded NOT_EXECUTED in every receipt; reopening the mutative path requires human authorization.

Authority classes action and model_scenario have no store deployed at G4 and are recorded as NO_STORE_DEPLOYED_AT_G4 in each manifest; key custody is OpenBao transit in bootstrap dev mode (in-memory, not durable across OpenBao restarts).
Single custodian for transit keys in the PoC stack: dual control of key access is not exercised.
Trace fields not produced by the ops plane (GovernedContext of C1-C8 boundaries) are emitted as null and listed as unavailable, never fabricated.
action_adapter_timeout and edge_partition faults are not observable by the ops plane at G4 and are reported as such in /posture.

The Compose carrier has no scheduler: the 15-minute backup cadence is enforced by the Helm CronJob; with Compose it requires a host scheduler, and RPO compliance is exported as ocor_recovery_point_within_rpo.

Fault injection uses docker pause (not stop) to avoid destroying tmpfs-backed bootstrap state and the SPIRE agent attestation.
rollback_procedure_verified: Mechanically reviewed and exercised in the tests: every Compose stage is torn down with `down -v --remove-orphans` and the kind namespace/PV/cluster are deleted by the fixture; reverting the task is a revert commit of deploy/helm/ocor-poc/ and the test module (no change to deploy/bootstrap, infra locks or sealed records); the OpenBao transit mount ocor-poc-transit can be disabled; vault recovery points are immutable history and are not deleted.
